# Stage 08 plan and todo ledger

## Frozen target

Close the finite-dimensional nonlinear geometry bridge between the exact
one-plaquette `SU(2)` heat-kernel initializer and the Stage 06 one-step norm.
The target consists of explicit quaternion product/logarithm bounds, exact
`2^4` incidence constants, a quantitative local Coulomb slice, an injective
plaquette-curvature chart on the physical tangent quotient, and an explicit
five-component good-chart action norm.

The target ends before the chart complement, dependent polymers, repeated RG,
reflection-positive continuum construction, or spectral-gap extraction.
